The '''Zeltron Artistry Guild''' was a guild that oversaw the export of [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] artwork to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
